integrity: The mathematics and numerical diagnostic are supplied. The analytic proof establishes the universal inequalities; finite simulations alone do not. No external independent audit or priority certification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Instantaneous biased capture into equally spaced lattice sites, independent Poisson clock, free Brownian segments, \(0\le\theta\le1\), \(D,L,r>0\). No finite-return-time, nonuniform lattice, non-Poisson clock, or general ratchet-potential extension is proved. Priority risk: a broader unlocated regenerative-transport theorem might subsume the parameter-specific sharp order; published drift and symmetric diffusion are explicitly excluded from independent originality claims.
title: Sharp dispersion envelope for biased periodic capture of Brownian motion
